The concept underneath Tencent’s Agent Memory is a semantic pyramid. Raw conversations become atoms, atoms roll up into scenarios, scenarios roll up into a persona, and every layer stays as readable markdown you can open, audit, and edit.

That auditability is the actual breakthrough. Vector memories fail silently because nobody can inspect them. A memory you can read and correct turns your assistant’s picture of you into something you own instead of something you hope is accurate.

Uses a semantic pyramid: raw conversations → atoms → scenarios → persona, all stored as readable markdown
Auditability is the key breakthrough — unlike vector memories, you can inspect, edit, and own your agent's memory
